13.name: A Hare-y Situation
13.overview: A woman says her beloved rabbit suffered a fatal injury while in a man's care; he denies responsibility and argues that she's really after his money.

13.name: Love Loans
13.overview: A woman says she financed her boyfriend through hard times and was repaid with betrayal; he argues that he never cheated and owes her nothing.

13.name: Little Sister, Big Problem
13.overview: A man says his sister broke her promise to repay him; she says he's forgotten all she's done for him.

13.name: The Vanishing Vehicle
13.overview: A woman says she bought a broken SUV that disappeared; her former friend argues that he can't be expected to refund a vehicle that drove right out of the dispute.

13.name: Teacup Trouble
13.overview: The new owner says her puppy was diagnosed with parvovirus within 24 hours, while the pet shop owners argue that the dog was healthy and the diagnosis was wrong.

13.name: Cruise Control
13.overview: An aunt says her niece stopped making payments on a loan for a cruise, while the niece argues that extra charges sank their agreement.

13.name: Bite Night
13.overview: A man says a dog attack left his pet injured, while his neighbor argues that the veterinary bills don't pass the sniff test.

13.name: Gas Me Up
13.overview: A woman says her roommate always found excuses not to pay utilities, while he says he always drove her around and paid for other expenses.

13.name: Triple No!
13.overview: A driver says a mechanic failed to properly fix her cars, while the mechanic argues that she caused her own troubles.

13.name: Maul-ti-poo Mayhem
13.overview: A woman says her maltipoo suffered devastating injuries, while her neighbor says his pit bull is not aggressive -- and she escalated the situation.

13.name: Who's That Kicking Down My Door?
13.overview: A landlord says his tenant left behind unpaid rent and havoc, while the tenant says the roommates made his life miserable.

13.name: Are You Fur Real?
13.overview: One woman says she was promised two puppies from a planned breeding arrangement, while the other says she ended the deal when they ended their friendship.

13.name: Unpaid Work, Unfinished Business
13.overview: A contractor says a home restoration job was done, and additional work was declined, while the homeowner says the house was torn apart and left unfinished.

13.name: Machine Misdeal
13.overview: A man says he's still owed money for a "skidsteer," while his former friend argues that he got stuck with a machine that belongs in the scrapyard.

13.name: The Feline Is Mine
13.overview: One side of a family says a teenager left his treasured pet with Grandma during a vacation; Grandma says she's grown attached and doesn't want to give it back!

13.name: Case of the Petty Ex
13.overview: A woman says she covered a car repair bill for her ex and got stuck with the payments; he argues that she offered to help before abruptly ending the relationship.

13.name: You Better Call Tyrone
13.overview: A casino-themed birthday bash leaves a man feeling like he lost a bet: he says he deserves his deposit back after canceling early; the planner argues that the money was already committed to vendors.

13.name: Car Ex-Change
13.overview: A woman says her ex promised to make payments and maintain a car, while he argues that she never followed through on transferring ownership.

13.name: Battering Scam
13.overview: A man says he was sold a used vehicle in poor condition; the seller argues that he is being blamed for someone else's scam.

13.name: The Last Supper
13.overview: A couple say their former church friend crashed their truck and refuses to pay for the damage; she argues that a faulty tire is responsible for the accident.

13.name: Barking Up the Wrong Tree
13.overview: One neighbor says his dog was seriously injured in an off-leash encounter, and he was stuck with thousands of dollars in veterinary bills; the other says it was simply a brief scuffle.

13.name: Bed and Wreck-fest
13.overview: A short-term rental's landlord says his tenant allowed unauthorized guests, who left the property in disarray; the tenant says the guests took over the arrangement, and the landlord knew about it.

13.name: Mister Big Bucks
13.overview: A man says he repeatedly helped a friend with car expenses and was never repaid; the ex-friend argues that repayment was never part of the deal.

13.name: Three-Wheel Overdrive
13.overview: A bargain truck buyer says the vehicle was falling apart; the man he calls the seller argues that he merely brokered the deal and isn't responsible.

13.name: First Birthday, Last Straw!
13.overview: A milestone birthday ends with disappointment and demands for a refund: a mother says the decorations and party favors failed to meet expectations, while the decorator argues that she went above and beyond despite difficult circumstances.

13.name: Title Waves
13.overview: A woman says she returned an SUV after discovering problems and never got her refund; her ex argues that she still owes money and says she still has the vehicle.

13.name: Wig Out
13.overview: A customer says a wig didn't fit and wasn't what she wanted; the shop owner says the purchase was approved and non-refundable.

13.name: Keyed Off
13.overview: A former tenant says there was a promise of a year-long living arrangement, then she was abruptly kicked out; the homeowner argues that she was only ever a temporary guest, who couldn't follow the rules.

13.name: Raggedy Van
13.overview: A buyer says she was sold a minivan with a dying transmission; the seller argues that it ran fine, and that's the risk of buying a used vehicle.

13.name: One Bad Move
13.overview: A woman says she moved in to help care for her friend's family during a medical crisis only to be hit with a restraining order and forced out.

13.name: One Bad Move (Part 2)
13.overview: A woman says she moved in to help care for her friend's family during a medical crisis only to be hit with a restraining order and forced out.

13.name: Rubbed the Wrong Way
13.overview: A massage therapist says his client's review twisted an innocent question into something inappropriate; the client says his behavior crossed a line and made her uncomfortable.

13.name: Un-Split Rent
13.overview: A woman says she covered her friend's unpaid rent with help from her father, while the friend argues that everyone knew her seasonal income meant she couldn't always pay.

13.name: The Impatient Driver
13.overview: A woman says an SUV swerved into her lane; the other driver argues that the woman was speeding and is exaggerating the damage.

13.name: Fat Chance at Repayment
13.overview: A funeral trip turns into a bitter battle over grief and money: one woman says she paid for flights and loans out of kindness, while the other argues that the financial help came with changing terms and unexpected strings attached.

13.name: Mural of the Story
13.overview: An artist says he completed most of a custom mural before being threatened and driven off the job, while the truck owner argues that the mural was barely started and needed to be completely redone.

13.name: Keep the Same Energy!
13.overview: A woman says she let her friend use her utility account and got stuck paying the balance; the other argues that she was making payments and unfairly left in the dark.

13.name: Truth, Lies and Mobile Buys!
13.overview: A mobile home buyer says he's still owed money after a deal fell apart; the seller argues that a new buyer repaid him and settled everything.

13.name: Suburban Legends
13.overview: A woman says her friend misrepresented the used SUV he sold her and kept dodging a refund; he argues that she bought it as-is and skipped the test drive.
